records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 — Limiting top-level domains to five letters prevents administrators from saving valid embedding hosts such as example.museum.
records.rationale: The diff shows in app/models/embeddable_host.rb line 2 a regex validation: `/\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i`. The `[a-z]{2,5}` part limits TLDs to 2-5 characters.
